# Parse, Don't Pray: The Case for Data Validation

> A Quarto RevealJS presentation by Indrajeet Patil.

Explore the benefits of Pydantic and Zod for runtime validation, type safety, focused contract testing, and safer input boundaries. The deck uses Pydantic 2.14.3 and Zod 4.6.7 APIs and covers parsed outputs, coercion, minimal type-inference examples, contract tests, mutable versus frozen configurations, and JSON Schema limitations. It distinguishes validation from authorisation and transport-level protections.
